utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, I’m glad you brought up the book club—what are you thinking for our next read?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Mara — how about something a little lighter this time, maybe a good mystery or a short novel?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds perfect to me—how about a cozy mystery or a short novel we can finish in a couple weeks?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what book are we reading next?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me confirm the shortlist first, then I’ll let you know which one we picked.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — just send me the pick when you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we have for the book club supplies. What do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks—maybe just some extra notebooks and pens if we’re low. I might be forgetting something, so let me know what else is missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies and see if we’re low on notebooks, pens, or anything else for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what the book club is reading this month.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we’re doing a pretty long novel this month, but I’d want to check the schedule before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—no rush. Just let me know when you’ve checked the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we meeting at your place for book club, or should I bring chairs?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m not totally sure yet—I just heard it might be at my place, but I should confirm. If you bring chairs, that’d be really helpful just in case.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring a couple of chairs and wait for your confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard this month’s pick is a real page-turner—everyone’s been buzzing about it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ha, sounds like the kind of book that keeps folks up late. If you need a spare chair or a lamp for the meeting, I’ve got you covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so kind of you, Gus—I'll keep you in mind if we need an extra chair or a brighter lamp. Folks are already curious, so I think this meeting’s going to be lively!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, absolutely—you should come to book club with us this week! I’ll send you the details right now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, thanks, Quinn — send me the location and time when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — we’re meeting at my place on Thursday at 7 PM. I’ll text you the address now!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what’s the latest on the book club?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are we still meeting Thursday at 7?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, Thursday at 7 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m glad you brought up book club — I can help get us organized. What book are you thinking we should read next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Rosa — I was thinking we could keep it easy and pick something everyone can get through. Maybe a good mystery or a short novel?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a great idea — something light and easy to finish would keep everyone happy. Want to shortlist a few mysteries and I can help us pick one?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll tell everyone the book club plan and make sure we’re all set for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. Just let me know the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and confirm the time and place soon. You can count on me to get everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the book club. I’m a little scattered today, but I’m in if you’re still going.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I’m still going. We can keep it low-key if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli — low-key sounds perfect. I’ll come by and try to keep my notes straight this time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I’d love to hear how the book club’s been going—are folks reading anything fun this month?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, it’s been nice—someone picked a mystery this month, so there’s been a lot to talk about. I can tell you more when I get back from errands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds fun—I love a good mystery. Catch me when you’re back, and tell me what everyone thinks!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, you should come by the book club this week—it’ll be a good crowd, and I can save you a spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I might just do that—thanks for saving me a spot. I’ll try not to show up too late again.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries at all—I’ll keep your seat open. Just swing by whenever you can, and we’ll catch you up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still getting a feel for the book club—what are you reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: We’re on "The Little Paris Bookshop" this week, and I usually like to read a few chapters each evening. If you want, I can bring you the schedule for next time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be great, thanks. I’d like to take a look and see if I can make the next one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’d love to make book club work, but I need to check the school pickup schedule first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — just let me know what the pickup schedule looks like, and I’ll help find a time that works.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Mara — I’ll check the pickup schedule tonight and text you a couple of open windows. Then we can pick the easiest one for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ve got a few book club folks from different circles—want me to connect you and see who’s in for the next meeting?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, please do — I’d love to be connected and see who’s in for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check with everyone and put together who’s in for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Pia — I’ve got a few chairs and a folding table if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be a big help, Gus — I just want to make sure we have enough space and don’t end up scrambling at the last minute.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — I can bring them by early so we’re set before everyone arrives.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the book club meets at the community center on Maple Street, right after dinner. I’ll bring my notes and make sure I’m there a few minutes early.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — thank you. I’ll have everything ready and meet you there right after dinner.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll see you at the community center on Maple Street right after dinner.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are we still meeting for book club this Thursday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think so, but let me double-check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — just let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the book club. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you keep an eye on snacks and extra chairs? I’ll handle the sign-up list and books.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll take care of the snacks and extra chairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’d love to know what the book club is reading this week.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—uh, I think it’s the new mystery one, unless I missed the swap again. I should probably check the notice before I confuse us both.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No worries—if you check the notice, just let me know and I’ll catch up with the right book too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so the book club is actually meeting this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on this week — I heard we’re meeting Thursday evening at Marcy’s place.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, Thursday at Marcy’s place — got it. Are we still reading the same book?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, nice — how’s the book club been going lately?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s been alright, thanks — I’ve been keeping up with it when I can. The group’s been a small comfort lately.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear — sometimes a small, steady thing is exactly what helps. What are you reading with them these days?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club—sounds like something I’d probably enjoy if I remember to show up. What book are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re doing "The Night Circus" this week—pretty easy read. If you want, I can text you the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, thanks—my memory’s a bit slippery these days. Text me the time and I’ll do my best to be there.
